title: gymnadenia conopsea var. intermedia
intro: Gymnadenia conopsea var. intermedia, commonly known as the intermediate summer lady's tresses, is a variant of the Gymnadenia conopsea species, a type of orchid native to Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and antiseptic, which can help to relieve respiratory issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia conopsea var. intermedia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
